lines.t: (Verse 1 – The Wound)
Yeah, little boy with a glove on, look at me dad
Swingin’ for the fences just to make my pops glad
You ain’t in the stands, so I built You in the sky
Turned YahuShua to my coach, tryna catch His eyeOpened up the Book, made it into my bat
Every verse that I swung was a crack at the fact
That I never heard “son, I’m proud you’re mine”
So I sharpened every Scripture like a landmineZeal on ten, but the wound on bleed
Heart full of doctrine, soul full of need
Pointin’ out sin like I’m savin’ Your name
Really I was beggin’ You to put me in the gameTold my ex, told my friends what they doin’ ain’t right
But I never let You search my own heart in the light
Used theology as armor, pain as a shield
Didn’t know my hidden guilt was the sword in the fieldBottle in my hand when the echo got loud
When the silence said “you failed him, you’ll never make him proud”
So I drank to forget, then I wrote to defend
I was swingin’ at the devil but I cut up my friends(Hook)
I was tryna show Daddy how high I could climb
How hard I could hustle, how pure I could rhyme
Wielded His word from a wound in my chest
Till His love cut through and put that pride to restNow I’m done with that fake game, frontin’ for the crowd
I’m seated in the heavens where the blood cried loud
From a child of performance to a son by grace
He said “well done” before I even ran the race(Verse 2 – The Break)
One night I crashed at the foot of the throne
All my “Thus says The Lord” got thrown like stones
And the same word I used like a bat on the field
Became the two‑edged blade that made my secrets yieldHe replayed every moment I was breathin’ out fire
How I covered over fear with a prophet attire
Showed me that the “wrath of the saint” never heals
It was my father-hunger grindin’ under the wheelsHe said, “Son, you don’t guard Me, I bled for you
You don’t stand in My shadow to improve My view
I was pleased when the nails hit, love already signed
You were carved in My hands ‘fore you changed your mindYou been swingin’ for approval that I gave at the cross
You been preachin’ like a boss but livin’ like you lost
Put the bat down, let the glove drop, come here
Let Me break that orphan heart and delete that fear”Then the courtroom flipped, gavel hit, case closed
All my self‑defense speeches got exposed
But instead of condemnation, I heard one thing
“Welcome home, My son – feel the joy of your King”(Hook)
I was tryna show Daddy how high I could climb
How hard I could hustle, how pure I could rhyme
Wielded His word from a wound in my chest
Till His love cut through and put that pride to restNow I’m done with that fake game, frontin’ for the crowd
I’m seated in the heavens where the blood cried loud
From a child of performance to a son by grace
He said “well done” before I even ran the race(Verse 3 – His Game)
Now I step to the plate with a whole new stance
A dead man walkin’ in a resurrection dance
No audition for affection, that contract’s sealed
I’m accepted in the Beloved, that’s the whole fieldAlready in the clubhouse, seated with the Champ
He lit the scoreboard up before I left the camp
So I ain’t gotta flex when I speak His name
I just echo His mercy, that’s His GAMEHis game ain’t clout, it’s a cross and a crown
Where the greatest take towels and wash feet down
Where the hard bars hit like “Father, forgive”
And the hook is His blood shoutin’ “live, child, live”Now when I quote Scripture, it’s a key, not a knife
Not a bat in my hand but the bread of life
I don’t preach to be right, I confess to be free
I don’t judge from the dugout, I invite to the TreeThe world’s game says earn it, grind till you break
His GAME says “It’s finished,” drink all that grace
I was tryin’ to make Dad proud swingin’ in the dark
Now Abba’s in the bleachers with His Name on my heart(Bridge)
No more orphan in the mirror with a Bible as a gun
No more sermons as a weapon, no more “look what I’ve done”
I’m a son in the light, with the scars in His palms
Hear the thunder of His love in the quiet of His psalms(Hook – Final)
I was tryna show Daddy how high I could climb
How hard I could hustle, how pure I could rhyme
Wielded His word from a wound in my chest
Till His love cut through and put that pride to restNow I’m runnin’ His GAME, not the world’s charade
Grace on my jersey, His blood on the blade
From a child of performance to a son by grace
He said “well done” the day He took my place
